personas.description: SF resident or visitor seeking a library branch with free Wi-Fi and open hours.
Researcher compiling a verified dataset of SFPL branches with sourced values.

jobs_to_be_done.description: Find an SFPL branch near me that is open now and offers free Wi-Fi.
Compile every SFPL branch with address, weekly hours, and Wi-Fi status, each value evidenced.

requirements.description: List every SFPL branch with address, weekly opening hours, and free Wi-Fi yes/no, each value with a cited source.
Treat sfpl.org as the primary publisher for branches, hours, and Wi-Fi; its values need no second source.
Cross-check branch addresses against data.sfgov.org as a secondary publisher; flag mismatches for review.
Use only public, read-only sources; jurisdiction San Francisco, California, USA; completion when every branch has all three values evidenced.

constraints: Public, read-only sources only; jurisdiction San Francisco, California, USA.
sfpl.org is primary for branches, hours, and Wi-Fi; its values need no second source.
data.sfgov.org is a secondary cross-check for branch addresses only.
Done means every branch listed with address, weekly hours, and Wi-Fi yes/no, each value with evidence.
Run budget USD 5.0; elapsed run time unknown until execution, so targets must be feasibility-checked.
non_goals: No paid, private, or write-access sources.
No second source required for sfpl.org-published values.
No coverage beyond San Francisco Public Library branches.
No real-time occupancy or service-quality data.
